landing.heroTitle:
Learn GRAFCET and Ladder

by simulating them
landing.heroTagline: Design, simulate and test your automation logic with animated HMIs, right in your browser.
landing.heroBadges: Free and open source · No install · No account · No personal data
landing.heroSceneLabel: 3D animation of a box-sorting station: a conveyor brings each box and cylinders sort it by height.
landing.showcaseGrafcetAlt: The Studomate editor simulating a GRAFCET
landing.showcaseLadderAlt: The Studomate editor simulating a Ladder diagram
landing.demoVideoLabel: Demo of building and simulating a project with Studomate
landing.logicIntro: GRAFCET and Ladder in the same project, sharing the same variables.
landing.machineIntro: Connect your program to an HMI, a 3D scene or a real Arduino board.
landing.showcaseGrafcetText: Draw steps, transitions and branches, then follow the GRAFCET as it runs: active steps, true conditions, running actions.
landing.showcaseLadderText: Build rungs with contacts, coils, timers and counters, and watch power flow through them during simulation.
landing.showcaseHmiText: Build animated supervision pages (lights, buttons, tanks, moving objects) wired to the same variables as your programs.
landing.showcaseScene3dText: Connect your program to a virtual 3D plant (conveyors, cylinders, sensors) and watch the machine respond in real time.
landing.showcaseScene3dAlt: 3D scene of a box-sorting station driven by Studomate
landing.showcaseArduinoText: Load your program onto a real Arduino Uno R3 board, or use its inputs and outputs during simulation, straight from Chrome or Edge.
landing.whyIntro: Studomate exists to cut the friction of learning automation down to almost nothing.
landing.reasonFrictionText: No install, no licence, no PLC or I/O cards to set up. You focus on the logic, not the tool.
landing.reasonAllInOneText: GRAFCET, Ladder and animated HMIs in the same environment, with variables shared across all three. No free tool combines the three.
landing.reasonShortLoopText: Errors are flagged while you edit, not only when you start the simulation. A fast, visual right to make mistakes.
landing.audienceTeachers: Teachers and trainers in automation / electrical engineering
landing.featureSimulationText: Step-by-step or continuous execution, with live visualisation of states, transitions and variables.
landing.featureManualText: Complete help available straight from the app.
landing.featureCloudText: Projects stored locally or in the cloud, with link sharing.
landing.step1Text: Nothing to install — it all runs in the browser.
landing.step2Title: Create a project or start from an example
landing.step2Text: Start from scratch or open one of the ready-made templates.
landing.step3Text: Check the structure, then run the logic and watch the system react.
landing.trainingIntro: Guided modules to master GRAFCET, then Ladder, with exercises you can simulate in the app.
landing.trainingA0Summary: Automation, variables, basic logic and the scan cycle.
landing.trainingA1Summary: Steps, transitions, actions, OR and AND branches.
landing.trainingA2Summary: Contacts, coils, latching, set/reset coils and edges.
landing.trainingA4Summary: Implement a GRAFCET in Ladder: one network per transition, two programs, actions, time and faults.
landing.trainingA5Summary: OR and AND divergences, stopping a sequence, limits of one network per transition and the three-block method.
landing.templatesIntro: Open a pre-configured project and explore it at your own pace.
landing.durabilityNoLockInText: Your projects are files you export and keep. The schema is versioned: a project exported today will still open after the tool is updated.
landing.durabilityIndependenceText: The code is free under the AGPL v3 licence: if the project stops, it can be forked or self-hosted.
landing.privacyText: No email required, no personal data stored, no tracking cookies. Authentication uses a nickname, and usage statistics are anonymous.
landing.sourceCodeText: The source code is public: read it, report an issue or contribute.

about.title: About Studomate
about.missionBody: Studomate is a teaching tool for automation: learning, designing and simulating GRAFCET, Ladder and HMIs, right in the browser.
about.missionBody2: It exists to cut the friction of learning automation down to almost nothing: no install, no licence, no PLC to configure.
about.differentiatorLabel: Its differentiator: everything in the same environment

offeringItems.title: Editing and simulation
offeringItems.text: Automation logic: sequences, transitions, virtual I/O, timers, counters, analog values.

offeringItems.title: Clear visualisation
offeringItems.text: Active states, evaluated transitions, outputs and external effects.

offeringItems.title: Learning modes
offeringItems.text: Step-by-step, full scan and continuous execution.

offeringItems.title: 3D scenes
offeringItems.text: A virtual plant (carton sorting, traffic lights, drilling, elevator) whose sensors and actuators are bound to the project's variables.

offeringItems.title: Hardware configuration
offeringItems.text: Map variables to the pins of an Arduino Uno R3 board, upload the program, simulate with real I/O and observe the board while it runs.

offeringItems.title: Analysis tools
offeringItems.text: Variable cross-references, project templates and vector PDF export.

offeringItems.title: French and English
offeringItems.text: Interface, manual and expressions available in both languages.

valueItems.title: Mixed use
valueItems.text: Classroom demos, homework exercises, collaborative corrections.

valueItems.title: Short correction loop
valueItems.text: Errors are flagged while editing, not only when the simulation starts.

ownershipItems.title: Local first
ownershipItems.text: Your projects are stored in your browser and can be exported as files. The schema is versioned and migrations are automatic: a project exported today will still open after updates.

ownershipItems.title: Optional cloud
ownershipItems.text: An account, with or without an email, lets you back up your projects to the cloud and share them by link. Without an account, nothing leaves your browser.

ownershipItems.title: Open and tracker-free
ownershipItems.text: The code is free under the AGPL v3 licence. Studomate uses no tracking cookies.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.purposeBody: These terms govern access to and use of Studomate, a teaching application dedicated to learning, designing and simulating automated systems. The tool provides interactive spaces to represent, simulate and understand the various languages, diagrams and logic of industrial automation. By accessing Studomate, the user acknowledges having read and accepted these terms.
terms.usageBody: Studomate is designed for supervised educational and professional use: teaching, training, self-learning or technical demonstration. The user agrees to:
usageItems: use the platform in compliance with the law and the rights of others;
not misuse the application for unlawful, commercial or malicious purposes;
not modify or attempt to access the source code without authorisation;
credit Studomate in any public use that incorporates it.
terms.accountsBody: The current version of Studomate requires no sign-up. Projects and simulations are stored locally in files. The user is responsible for backing up their files. No personal data is sent to external servers without explicit consent.
terms.ipBody: All technical, graphical and conceptual content of Studomate (interface, engine, icons, structure) remains the property of its authors. Any reproduction, modification or distribution without written authorisation is prohibited. The user remains the owner of the projects and creations they develop on the platform.
terms.liabilityBody: Studomate aims to make automated systems easier to understand. It is a teaching tool, not certified industrial software. No guarantee is given as to the absolute accuracy of the simulations, compatibility with real equipment or long-term data retention. Use of the application is at the user's sole responsibility.
terms.evolutionBody: Studomate is continuously evolving. Features may be changed, added or suspended without notice, in particular during testing or maintenance phases. The team strives to keep the service stable and transparent.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.introBody: This privacy policy describes how Studomate handles users' personal and technical data. It aims to ensure transparency and to spell out the privacy choices available.
privacy.collectedBody: Studomate collects no identifying personal data automatically. By default, the projects a user creates are stored locally in their browser and are sent to no remote server. Data leaves the user's device in only two cases, described below: audience measurement (§3) and, if they choose to create an account, accounts and cloud backup (§4).
privacy.analyticsBody: Studomate uses Umami (hosted in the European Union) to measure site traffic: number of visits, pages viewed, traffic sources, device type, and a few anonymous usage events (creating a project, starting a simulation). These measurements are taken without cookies, without storing the IP address and without any way to identify or track a user from one visit to the next. No data is sold or used for advertising.
privacy.accountsBody: Creating an account is optional: without an account, Studomate runs entirely locally and no data is sent to our servers. By creating an account, a user can back up their projects to the cloud and access them on another device.
accountsItems: Anonymous account: nickname and password, no email address.
Data stored: an account identifier, the email or nickname, and only the projects the user chooses to save to the cloud.
privacy.accountsHosting: This data is hosted by our processor Supabase, on infrastructure located in the European Union. Each account can access only its own data (isolation enforced at the database level). No data is sold or used for advertising.
privacy.securityBody: Studomate is committed to a high level of data protection and to never exploiting data for commercial or advertising purposes. Exchanges with the cloud are encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and access to saved projects is restricted to the account that created them. Users remain responsible for the security of files they export locally.
privacy.cookiesBody: Studomate uses no tracking cookies. Only technical data is stored locally for projects to work correctly (internal identifiers, simulation states, saved settings).
privacy.rightsBody: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), any user may:
rightsItems: erase the local data in their browser at any time;
export or manually back up their projects at any time;
request deletion of their account and associated projects by contacting the team (§8).
privacy.contactBody: For any question about privacy or data handling:
